title: Citus: scale-out (add a 3rd worker group + rebalance shards onto it)
description: The future nexus-cli CitusAdapter `scale-out` verb -- after a new worker Patroni group (citus-worker3 pair + VIP .214) is stood up, registers it with citus_add_node('worker3.citus.nexus.lab', 5432) and runs rebalance_table_shards() so existing shards move onto the new worker online. Demonstrates horizontal elastic growth of the distributed table with no downtime. (Forward-declared: starts passing once the CitusAdapter scale-out impl + the worker3 overlay land.)

observe.what: worker3 added to pg_dist_node (groupid grows); rebalance_table_shards('events') moves a share of shards onto worker3; final count(distinct nodename) in citus_shards == 3
sudo -u postgres psql -h /var/run/nexus-citus -d citus -c 'SELECT nodename,count(*) FROM citus_shards GROUP BY nodename' -- shards now spread across 3 workers
sudo -u postgres psql -h /var/run/nexus-citus -d citus -c 'SELECT * FROM citus_rebalance_status()' -- online rebalance progress

whatProves: Citus scales horizontally online: adding a worker group + rebalance_table_shards redistributes shards with no downtime -- the elastic-growth story for PG-native sharding, complementing the Vitess Reshard equivalent.
